_note: Corrections for bugs in the Claude Design files, applied to the DESIGN side before comparing, so the build must implement them. Every entry needs a reason and the user's approval. Keep this list minimal: anything not listed here must match the design exactly. 'js' may tag elements with classes (the design has no class names) or rewrite an inline value into a pure-CSS equivalent the build can use; 'css' does the styling.

fixes.reason: A stray closing in 'VangAI Home.dc.html' (after the 'The good news?' block) closes the page wrapper early. That wrapper set the font (Archivo) and the text colour (#2B2118), so below it 69 texts fall back to Times New Roman and headings without their own colour fall back to pure black. All other pages and the brand guide use Archivo and #2B2118. The same stray tag also ends the sticky header's container, so on Home the header scrolls away after the problem section while it stays pinned on every other page. The fix moves the orphaned sections back inside the page wrapper, which restores all three.
fixes.build: Body text uses Archivo and the brand dark #2B2118 everywhere, and the header stays pinned on every page.
fixes.approved: 2026-09-25 by the user (font); colour is the same bug, applied 2026-09-25
fixes.js: (()=>{ const w=[...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(d=>(d.getAttribute('style')||'').includes('min-height: 100vh')); if(!w)return; const rest=[]; for(let n=w.nextSibling;n;n=n.nextSibling) rest.push(n); rest.forEach(n=>w.appendChild(n)); })()

fixes.reason: On a 390px phone, single long words in large headings are wider than the screen ('VangMessage' at 58px on Product, 'conversations' at 62px on Data & privacy), so the page scrolls sideways. Headings scale to 11.5vw below about 540px wide. Wider screens keep the design size exactly. Applied to all three product headings and all four legal-page titles so matching headings stay the same size.
fixes.build: Product channel h2: font-size min(58px, 11.5vw). Legal page h1: font-size min(62px, 11.5vw).

fixes.js: (()=>{ document.querySelectorAll('div').forEach(d=>{ const s=d.getAttribute('style')||''; if(!/minmax\(300px/.test(s)||!/rgb\(43, 33, 24\)/.test(s))return; d.classList.add('qa-quote-outer'); [...d.children].forEach(c=>{ if(/minmax\(0px, 1fr\) minmax\(0px, 1fr\)/.test(c.getAttribute('style')||'')) c.classList.add('qa-quote-inner'); }); }); })()
fixes.reason: The dark 'No website yet? We build those too.' card requires at least 300px per column and places the 191px 'Request a quote' button in a 117px column, so on a 390px phone the button sticks out 41px and the page scrolls sideways.
fixes.build: At max-width 480px: the card uses 24px padding and one column, and its inner price box stacks the preview above the price and button.

fixes.reason: On 360 to 375px phones every page scrolls sideways (376 to 380px wide) because auto-fit grids have fixed minimum columns: the closing call-to-action band (minmax(280px) plus 56px padding) on every page, the booking and message cards on Contact (minmax(340px)), and the 340px hero demo wrapper on Home. minmax(min(Npx, 100%), 1fr) is identical wherever the design already fits (390px and wider) and lets the column shrink on smaller phones.
fixes.build: All auto-fit grids use minmax(min(Npx, 100%), 1fr). The hero demo container has max-width: 100%.

fixes.js: (()=>{ const h=document.querySelector('h1'); if(!h)return; const fs=getComputedStyle(h).fontSize; if(fs==='76px') h.classList.add('qa-h1-hero'); else if(document.title.startsWith('About')||/We build the front desk/.test(h.textContent)) h.classList.add('qa-h1-about'); })()
fixes.reason: Below 390px, single long words overflow the screen: 'customer' in the Home hero title (76px) and a word in the About title (62px). The Product demo side cards are 372px wide on a 360px phone (width 100% of a 340px row plus 16px padding, content-box), inside a 280px column. The heading limits are chosen so the design size is unchanged at 390px and wider (76/19.5vw = 390px, 62/16.4vw = 378px).
fixes.build: Home hero h1: font-size min(76px, 19.5vw). About h1: font-size min(62px, 16.4vw). Product demo (max-width 620px): the demo column and its children are max-width 100%, and the side card uses box-sizing border-box.

accepted.reason: All text colours stay exactly as in the design, including small coral labels, the active menu item, faded labels and chat timestamps (below the WCAG 4.5:1 guideline in places), by the user's decision.
